## What to do

Adapt the upstream skills doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/skills.md, 232 lines) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/skills.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/skills.ts (reference)
- Agent Skills standard: https://agentskills.io/specification

## Output

Create docs/skills.md

## How to adapt

1. **Locations**: Update all paths from `~/.pi/agent/skills/` to our paths. Document our skill discovery hierarchy:
   - Global: `~/.octo_pi/skills/`, `~/.agents/skills/`
   - Project: `.pi/skills/`, `.agents/skills/` in cwd and ancestors
   - Settings: `skills` array
   - CLI: `--skill <path>`

2. **How Skills Work**: The progressive disclosure concept is the same. Document our skill loading in the ResourceLoader.

3. **Skill Commands**: Document our `/skill:name` command format.

4. **Skill Structure**: The SKILL.md format is the same (per Agent Skills standard). Preserve the directory structure example.

5. **Frontmatter**: Document our YAML frontmatter parsing:
   - `name` — skill name (required)
   - `description` — description (required)
   - `preferred` — whether to prefer this skill
   - `disable_model_invocation` — whether to disable model invocation

6. **Validation**: Document our SKILL.md validation rules.

7. **Example**: Convert the example to reference our paths.

8. **Skill Repositories**: Document how to discover and install skill repositories.

## What to preserve verbatim

- The Agent Skills standard reference
- The SKILL.md directory structure
- The frontmatter schema
- The progressive disclosure concept
- The security warning about skill content

## Key upstream references to include

- [Agent Skills spec](https://agentskills.io/specification)
- [skills.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/skills.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All paths match our actual config directories
2. The frontmatter fields match our parser
3. The skill command format is accurate
